title: Denial of Service Detection
description: A denial-of-service attack attempts to make a service or network resource unavailable by generating excessive or abnormal traffic.
indicators: Repeated traffic toward the same destination service
investigation: Identify source IP addresses generating the traffic
Check packet and byte rates over time
Identify the targeted destination service and port
Check whether the service experienced degradation
Correlate the traffic with firewall and IDS logs
mitigation: Block or restrict confirmed malicious sources
Use network filtering or upstream protection
Monitor the targeted service for continued abnormal traffic

title: Bot Activity Detection
description: Bot activity occurs when compromised systems are controlled or coordinated by malicious infrastructure.
investigation: Identify the affected internal host
Inspect destination IP addresses and domains
Look for repeated communication patterns
Review DNS and network logs
Check the endpoint for signs of compromise
mitigation: Isolate the affected endpoint when appropriate

title: Network Infiltration Detection
description: Infiltration refers to unauthorized access or malicious activity in which an attacker gains access to a network or system.
investigation: Identify the suspected source and destination hosts
Determine when the suspicious activity began
Review authentication and network logs
Investigate unusual internal connections
Check affected systems for additional indicators of compromise

title: Web Attack Detection
description: Web attacks target web applications or services using malicious requests or abnormal application traffic.
investigation: Identify the targeted web service
Review HTTP and application logs
Identify suspicious source addresses
Look for repeated or automated requests
Check whether sensitive endpoints were targeted
mitigation: Review and strengthen application security controls
